about_the_game:
Hope: The Flickering Light is a thought-provoking puzzle game that challenges your logic, precision, and timing as you guide Luna, a determined girl from a village shrouded in darkness, in her search for the Eternal Flame — the only chance to break her homeland’s curse.

Armed with only a candle and the echoes of her past failed attempts, Luna must navigate a shifting underground world filled with traps, layered puzzles, and dangerous patterns. Each flicker of light is more than a tool — it’s a symbol of determination, persistence, and the belief that even in the darkest places, something bright remains.

Key Features

  • 🧠 Challenging Logical Puzzles
    Every level is a carefully crafted brainteaser that tests your memory, sequencing, and timing skills.

  • 🔁 Replayable Puzzle Design
    Experiment with different solutions to optimize your paths — perfection is earned, not given.

  • 🌌 Narrative-Driven Journey
    Uncover Luna’s story through minimalist storytelling, ambient clues, and layered symbolism.

  • 🔦 Light as a Mechanic and Metaphor
    Use your candle to activate switches, reveal paths, and guide your echo — each flame represents hope.

  • 🕯️ Echoes of the Past
    Your previous failed runs aren’t forgotten — they become allies, retracing your past and enabling puzzle layers.

  • ⌛ 4–6 Hours of Focused Gameplay
    Designed for players who seek tightly designed challenges in a serene, meaningful world.

  • 🎮 Minimalist Aesthetic, Maximum Impact
    Inspired by games like Journey and Inside, Hope delivers rich emotion with elegant simplicity.

If you're looking for a puzzle game that values brains over brute force, narrative over noise, and hope over despair — then light your candle, and begin your journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 or NVIDIA GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on most entry-level systems. No internet connection required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for players who want smooth performance and higher visual quality.

short_description: A logical puzzle game where timing and planning matter. Guide Luna through a cursed labyrinth using candlelight and echoes of past attempts to reach the Eternal Flame. Solve layered challenges and uncover meaning in every flicker of hope.
